page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a 4.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average tier for most compute tasks, with a Passmark CPU score of 18076.58 and a stress-ng multi-core performance of 16667.55. Memory performance is a notable strength, with the Passmark memory score rated as strong and a cached read-only memory bandwidth of 932.51 GB/sec. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and AES cryptography, which assist in workloads like static web serving, measured at 13.8 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations, achieving 16.27 million operations per second.

Lacking local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, this instance is not configured for heavy storage-bound databases or complex deep learning training. However, the dedicated CPU allocation and strong memory bandwidth offer high resource density and predictable performance for its hardware class. The instance is well-suited for workloads such as web serving, in-memory caching, software compilation, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
